steps.label: go to definition of double
steps.eval: (async () => { const p = (await go.rpc.AppService.Info()).projectPath + '/main.py'; const locs = await go.rpc.LangService.Definition(p, 6, 30); return (locs || []).map(l => l.path.split('/').slice(-2).join('/') + ':' + l.range.start.line); })()

steps.label: completion after os.pa
steps.eval: (async () => { const p = (await go.rpc.AppService.Info()).projectPath + '/main.py'; await go.rpc.LangService.DidChange(p, 50, 'import os\nos.pa\n'); const r = await go.rpc.LangService.Completion(p, 1, 5); await go.rpc.LangService.DidChange(p, 51, (await go.rpc.FileService.Read(p)).content); return (r.items || []).map(i => i.label).filter(l => l.startsWith('pa')).slice(0, 5); })()

steps.label: run main.py
steps.eval: (async () => { const p = (await go.rpc.AppService.Info()).projectPath + '/main.py'; const cfg = await go.rpc.RunService.ContextConfig({path: p, kind: 'main', name: 'main.py'}); await go.rpc.RunService.RunConfig(cfg, '', false); return cfg.type + ' ' + cfg.script; })()
